mechanism.name: operator-level componentwise-best supply, then A-level componentwise minimum

permitted_sources: the C1 registry (one block per cell)
step_1_operator_tuple.rule: tau, C_T, D1, D2, Abar := min over sources; D_lo := max over sources
step_1_operator_tuple.why_sound: each source certifies the SAME six quantities uniformly over the SAME cell. tau <= tau_C1 and tau <= tau_C2 both hold pointwise on the cell, so tau <= min holds; D >= D_lo_C1 and D >= D_lo_C2 both hold, so D >= max holds. This is the intersection of two valid bound sets on one domain and requires NO independence assumption between the sources.
step_1_operator_tuple.dependency_constraints_enforced: the mixed tuple must satisfy every Lemma Dv' premise in its own right: tau >= 1, C_T >= tau, D_lo > 0, Abar >= 1, and the r2 constants must not exceed their r1 counterparts. These are checked on the MIXED tuple by the pinned deflated_consume.atom_constants_r2, which raises DeflationRefusal otherwise. A mixed tuple that fails any premise is FORBIDDEN and the cell falls back to the best single source.
step_1_operator_tuple.whole_cell_validity: every source bound must be certified uniformly on the whole cell [e0-rho, e0+rho]. C1's block is exactly that interval; C2's sub-blocks tile it exactly at width <= 1/100 and are composed worst-over-cover. Both are therefore whole-cell bounds and their componentwise best is a whole-cell bound.
step_1_operator_tuple.correlation_handling: no statistical independence is assumed or needed; the combination is a conjunction of deterministic inequalities, not an averaging. Shared assumptions are therefore harmless to soundness - but they are NOT harmless to robustness, which is why the adoption floor below is stated separately.

mechanism.step_2_atom_constants: Lemma Dv' applied to the mixed tuple by the pinned deflated_consume.atom_constants_r2, with the universal kappa_1, kappa_2. Drift-aware per-cell norms were considered and EXCLUDED: they are plausibly valid by (P1) and worth 0.02-0.2 %, but C3 has not independently verified that premise and will not rest on an unverified tightening.

step_3_A_level_minimum.rule: A_j := min over {Lemma G, C1, C2, operator-mixed} componentwise, j in {A0,A1,A2}, with provenance recorded per cell per field
step_3_A_level_minimum.known_to_be_inert: C3 has established BEFORE freezing that the mixed supply dominates all three others componentwise on all four cells, so this minimum returns the mixed supply. It is pre-registered anyway, because a rule that is inert on this data must not be selected after observing that it is inert. If a future source broke the dominance, the rule would bind and would be the pre-registered one.

mechanism.determinism: the selector is a total order on rationals with no tolerance; ties resolve to the lexicographically first source name, which is recorded in provenance. No result-dependent choice is permitted at any point.
forbidden: mixing at the sub-block level and composing afterwards - proved identical to whole-cell mixing (min distributes over max), so any claimed gain would be spurious
taking a component from a source that does not certify it uniformly on the whole cell
substituting any order-3 quantity; C3 evaluates no candidate of F and passes order3 = None throughout
any selection made after the forecast is computed

baseline.measured_against: authoritative r5, i.e. the requirement under C2's frozen D4 rule = min over {G, C1, C2}
baseline.why_not_C1: C1 is two campaigns back. Measuring against it would inflate the reported improvement by roughly a factor of three (57/31/23 % against C1 versus 20/8/6 % against r5) and is the stale-baseline defect C2's reviews caught repeatedly.

material_tightening_test.applies_to: every cell C3 does not close whose baseline gap is > 0
material_tightening_test.rule: a still-open cell is MATERIALLY TIGHTENED iff its gap falls by at least 20 per cent of the r5 baseline gap
material_tightening_test.justification: inherited unchanged from C2's frozen gate rather than chosen for C3. The incumbent standard is the non-fitted choice; raising or lowering it for a successor that already knows its approximate prior would be the suspicious move. Cell 306 has baseline gap 0 and is therefore governed by the adoption floor, not by this test.

adoption_floor.name: K5 tail adoption floor
adoption_floor.rule: a cell whose Gamma < 0 is ADOPTABLE only if, in addition, EITHER (F1) Gamma < 0 also under a supply that does not rest on the Arb/FLINT taboo_certify surface - Lemma G is the only such supply presently available - OR (F2) Gamma < 0 survives inflating every atom constant by the factor 1.25.
adoption_floor.provenance: set prospectively by the INDEPENDENT C2 adjudicator as the standard for K5 tail adoption, before Campaign C3 existed. C3 inherits it verbatim and does not restate, reinterpret or soften it.
adoption_floor.why_inherited_rather_than_invented: C3 knows from committed C2 evidence, before this gate is frozen, that cell 306's best deterministic uniform-A margin is 1.1555 < 1.25 and that Lemma G does not close it - so C3 knows 306 will FAIL this floor. Inheriting an externally set floor unchanged is precisely what prevents that foreknowledge from being laundered into a weaker criterion. Any C3-authored floor that happened to admit 306 would be indistinguishable from outcome fitting.
adoption_floor.applies_to_cell_306: yes, identically to every other cell. No cell-specific carve-out exists.

classification.USEFUL: at least one universe cell has Gamma < 0 AND meets the adoption floor
classification.PARTIAL: at least one universe cell has Gamma < 0 but no such cell meets the adoption floor
classification.MATERIAL_TIGHTENING_ONLY: no universe cell has Gamma < 0, and every still-open cell with baseline gap > 0 is materially tightened
classification.MARGINAL: no universe cell has Gamma < 0, and at least one still-open cell with baseline gap > 0 is not materially tightened
classification.INVALID: a Lemma Dv' premise fails on the mixed tuple, a whole-cell validity condition fails, or the mechanism cannot be executed as specified
classification.ordering: evaluated in the order USEFUL, PARTIAL, MATERIAL_TIGHTENING_ONLY, MARGINAL, INVALID; the first match wins

decision_rule.USEFUL: proceed to freeze, qualification, authorization, execution, seal, consumption and independent adjudication, proposing for adoption exactly the cells that meet the adoption floor.
decision_rule.PARTIAL: proceed to the governed chain and propose NOTHING for adoption. Record the candidate closure and the exact floor component it fails. Publish the negative result. A candidate closure that fails the floor is not adopted merely because it exists.
decision_rule.MATERIAL_TIGHTENING_ONLY: STOP after publishing the result. No adoption, no coverage map r6. The tightening is recorded for a successor.
decision_rule.MARGINAL: STOP after publishing the result. No adoption, no r6.
decision_rule.INVALID: STOP immediately and publish the refusal.

r6_rule: coverage map r6 is generated if and only if an independent adjudicator hands over an adopting verdict with a non-empty adopted set. r5 and r4 remain immutable in every branch.
guard: REAL_SCIENTIFIC_COMPUTE = DENY throughout C3. No R-stage, no real order-3 address, no new expensive numerical probe, no AWS interaction. Deterministic exhaustion is NOT established by C3 and C3 may not assert it.
no_redefinition: after this gate is committed, no threshold, class, baseline, adoption floor or mechanism clause may be changed for Campaign C3. A successor needs a new gate frozen before its own forecast.

prior_evidence_known_at_freeze.disclosed_so_the_gate_cannot_be_read_as_: C3 computed the following from committed C2 artifacts BEFORE freezing this gate, and records them so a reviewer can judge whether the gate was fitted to them.
prior_evidence_known_at_freeze.implication_C3_accepts_in_advance: on this prior, C3 expects PARTIAL: 306 closes but fails the inherited adoption floor, and 307-309 do not close, with 308 and 309 falling short of the inherited 20 % material-tightening threshold. C3 freezes the gate knowing this and does not adjust it.
